description: Dataset for Can Urban Green Infrastructure Bend the Carbon Emission Curve? Green–Gray Infrastructure Coordination and Carbon Emission Intensity in Chinese Cities, 2006–2019 is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Zhen Peng. This dataset supports the study of the relationship between urban green–gray infrastructure coordination and carbon emission intensity in Chinese prefecture-level cities. It contains an unbalanced city-level panel covering 272 prefecture-level cities from 2006 to 2019, comprising 3,052 city-year observations. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
